problems: The blind guess (hooded robed figure with two legs) does not match. The drawing reads as a kettle: domed lid with knob, arched bail handle, spout on the left, and a body with a flat base. The only figure-like cue is the three flame tongues below the body, which could be read as legs.
Star 23362 ('right wall where the bail meets the body') sits at about (447,300), well outside the blue body outline, which has its right wall near x=350. It is not on the body.

The three flame tongues (25045, 24505, 23430) are detached below the base at y≈370–440 and drawn as open trapezoid cups, not flames. They do not rise from the base, so the fire reads as separate legs or stand.

Labels collide heavily around the lid and bail: 'knob on top of the lid', 'crown of the lid dome', 'left lug of the bail' and 'top of the bail, right side' overlap each other, and 'body rim just under the lid' runs into 'outer curve of the bail'. The labels are hard to read.

Star 24927 ('inside the lower-left of the base') is at about (258,326), inside the body, which is acceptable. Star 23685 (foot, bottom-right) at about (327,349) is on the base corner, which is acceptable. The spout tip 25985 at (200,258) and the spout-to-wall join 25606 at (222,316) are also acceptable.
The blue outline is a real closed silhouette and not a copy of the gold lines, so that requirement is met. The figure is upright with the spout on the left.
output.advice:
Redraw so the figure reads unambiguously as a kettle, keeping the upright orientation and the spout on the left.
1. Body: keep the vertical walls between about x=215 and x=350, y=225 to 355. Put the body rim 24305 at about (295,225) just under the lid. Keep the foot 23685 at about (327,349) as the bottom-right corner, and the lower-left base point 24927 inside the body at about (258,326).
2. Right wall: move 23362 from (447,300) to about (348,300) so it sits on the right wall where the bail meets the body.
3. Bail: draw an arched handle from the left lug 24845 near (262,165) up over the lid to the top-right 23231 near (358,153), with the outer curve 22479 at about (403,229) bulging outward. Keep the bail lugs on the body wall, not floating.
4. Lid: dome from about (262,165) to (358,153) with crown 24327 at the top centre (about (300,120)) and knob 24244 directly above it at about (297,139). Separate the crown label from the knob label.
5. Spout: keep tip 25985 at (200,258) tapering to the join 25606 at (222,316) on the left wall.
6. Flames: stop placing the tongues below the base as detached cups. Put them rising from the bottom of the body, with left tongue 25045 near (250,372), centre 24505 tallest at about (280,350) pointing up into the base, and right tongue 23430 near (330,365). Draw them as pointed flame shapes connected to the base, not open trapezoids. Alternatively, draw a small fire ring under the body and attach the tongues to it.
7. Labels: stagger leader lines so the lid and bail labels do not overlap, and move the outer-curve label away from the rim label."]
